text:
Maya: idea dump 1: start webinar with a real incident timeline (brief: traffic surge -> latency spike -> customer impact) then pivot to the playbook we used to recover and optimize. keeps it narrative + actionable.
Ava: love narrative-first. for promo we can split copy: human story for execs, technical tease for infra folks.
Carlos: agree. marketing needs: 2 hero taglines, 2 subject lines, 3 social copy variations, landing blurb, and gated checklist PDF. will draft.
Rory: speaker plan: Maya opens with story + architecture sketch, Ivan does tuning deep-dive (batching, cache, quant profiles), Sam covers ops & fallback. keep transitions tight.
Ivan: I'm in. can we limit deep-dive to 12 minutes with a single reproducible demo so we don't race the clock?
Maya: yes. demo split: 1) 45s user-facing micro-demo (fast path), 2) 2:30 technical replay (show key metrics and config diffs).
Sam: fallback SOP: if live demo P95 > 1.2s for >20s or errors >1.5% flip to recorded clip + pin note in chat. also have a short script for MC to read. I'll prepare.
Ava: landing page CTA options: Register / Download tuning checklist / Request pilot. Recommend 'Download tuning checklist' as primary to capture intent.
Carlos: tracking: use utm_campaign=webinar_playbook, utm_source=channel, utm_medium=email, utm_content=hookX. set up separate links for each hook.
Maya: run-of-show draft (total 50 min):
- 00:00 intro & problem hook (3 min)
- 03:00 incident timeline & customer impact (4 min)
- 07:00 architecture sketch + decisions (8 min)
- 15:00 micro-demo (1 min)
- 16:00 deep technical demo (12 min)
- 28:00 ops & fallback playbook (8 min)
- 36:00 customer case + ROI numbers (7 min)
- 43:00 CTA + next steps (2 min)
- 45:00 Live Q&A (5-10 min)
Ava: looks solid, leaves room for Qs. we'll plan for 50 to be safe.
Carlos: promotional timeline: announce 2 weeks out, reminder 3 days before, last push 24 hours before. set up A/B for subject lines and hero copy.
Maya: subject options?
Rory: subj A: 'When LLMs slow down: how we fixed a critical production spike'
Ivan: subj B: 'Practical tuning: batching, caching, and routing for production LLMs'
Ava: we'll A/B both via email and LinkedIn copy.
Sam: rehearsals: full dry-run Tue 11am PT, tech check Thu 9am PT (they reserve the stream), final go 30min before show. Ivan, Sam, can you commit to Tue?
Ivan: Tue ok. Sam: Tue ok, Thu conflict but will join final 30min.
Maya: demo stability checklist: fixed seed prompts (3), pinned model versions, pre-warmed KV cache, snapshot of model metrics to show. also ensure captions enabled.
Ava: social blurbs (short):
- short A: 'Scaling LLM UX? See the playbook we used to cut latency and cost.'
- short B: 'Ops + engineering: real steps to make LLMs reliable in production.'
- short C: 'Live demo: hot-swap fallback & tuning checklist included.'
Carlos: lead magnet: 1-page tuning checklist + 3 config snippets (batch sizes, cache TTLs, quant profile notes). gating = email + role checkbox (product/infra).
Maya: accessibility & recordings: captioning on, recording retention 60 days, post-webinar edit for on-demand.
deploy-bot: Reminder: rehearsal created (Tue 11am PT). stream channel reserved. recording retention set to 60 days.
Ava: final asks: customer quote (short), 3 canonical prompts from product, one-slide fallback diagram, and Ivan's demo script. can we have all assets by Mon EOD?
Ivan: demo script & prompts by Mon EOD.
Sam: fallback slide by Mon EOD; recorded clip ready Tue morning.
Carlos: I'll draft exec-facing blurb and paid social plan today.
Maya: I'll assemble runbook and shortlist speakers' talking points. thanks team 61; we'll reconvene after dry-run to finalize timings.
